question: An ICT distribution designer working for the owner receives a submitted product that differs from the product specified in the contract documents. The original product is unavailable due to shipping or manufacturing delay. Which action should the ICT distribution designer take? A. Reject the submittal after verifying compliance with applicable standards. B. Approve the submittal after asking about additional compensating warranty offerings. C. Approve the submittal after verifying code compliance. D. Approve the submittal after verifying all significant features of the originally specified product are met.
66-style connecting blocks (certain designs) can support up to what category of transmission performance? A. Category 3 B. Category 5 C. Category 5e D. Category 6 E. Category 6A
Open RFI’s should be reviewed on a __________ basis. A. daily B. bi-weekly C. weekly D. bi-monthly

Which two of the following apply during a project’s close out process? (Choose two.) A. Communicate discrepancies to responsible parties. B. Begin testing of installed infrastructure. C. Evaluate the surroundings of the project and report back to the communications distribution professional of these findings. D. Hire legal council for representation. E. Create schedule for completion of punch list.
Which of the following is the process of limiting fire and smoke using fire-resistive barriers? A. Suppression B. Prevention C. Compartmentation D. Detection

Placement of a buried OSP pathway in public Rights of Way may require a permit based on which of the following? A. Locating of other utilities B. Bonding and grounding of metallic conductors C. Fees calculated on distance D. Building entrance conduit plugging

For a backbone distribution system serving a usable floor space of ≈ 8,920 m2 (96,000 ft2), the MINIMUM slot area to be used for this back bone is A. ≈ 0.040 m2 (60 in2) B. ≈ 0.048 m2 (72 in2) C. ≈ 0.056 m2 (84 in2) D. ≈ 0.064 m2 (96 in2)

Which of the following is a method that an ICT distribution designer would use for clash detection with other disciplines? A. Statistical Quantitative Analysis B. Interference Fit Verification C. ICT pathway design D. Building Information Modeling Coordination

Which two of the following are included in the ICT distribution designer’s role of vendor and contractor coordination? (Choose two.) A. Produce ICT closeout documentation for the owner to provide the record documentation of the installation. B. Assist in the resolution of unforeseen conditions, change orders, RFIs, and changes to the project’s critical path. C. Monitor project schedule for delays. D. Communicate status to stakeholders. E. Conduct final ICT inspections to ensure standard and code compliance, design intent, and/or client requirements are met.
An RFQ usually provides more detail than RFP in selecting material such as A. delivery date. B. mounting option. C. make. D. color.

A client hired an ICT distribution designer who is designing some additional capacity for a customer owned aerial outside plant. Which of the following would be a PRIMARY consideration? A. Clearances will still be adequate with the added equipment. B. That all of the poles on the path are at least Class 3. C. Sufficient space exists to install additional guying if required. D. Utility coordination with public utilities verifies minimum inductive interference.

An ICT distribution designer is reviewing a client’s site information (spaces and pathways) to determine network technology and equipment selection. This is referred to as a ______ design process. A. logical network B. top-down C. functional D. bottom-up
For a cable tray installed within an ER, the RECOMMENDED access headroom is A. ≈ 152 mm (6 in). B. ≈ 203 mm (8 in). C. ≈ 254 mm (10 in). D. ≈ 305 mm (12 in).

Where would an ICT distribution designer working for a company responding to a RFP expect to find requirements concerning alternative dispute resolution in the scope of work (SOW)? A. It would be expected in the portion of the scope of work (SOW) containing technical considerations. B. It would not be expected in the scope of work (SOW). C. It would be expected in the section of the scope of work (SOW) containing legal requirements. D. It would be expected in the part of the scope of work (SOW) delineating acceptance requirements.

An ICT distribution designer is determining the size of the equipment room (ER). The building has a usable floor area of 1393.5 m2 (15,000 ft2). What is the MINIMUM size of the ER if the work area average is 9.29 m2 (100 ft2)? A. 9.29 m2 (100 ft2) B. 13.94 m2 (150 ft2) C. 15 m2 (160 ft2) D. 18.58 m2 (200 ft2)
In the context of producing sound, molecules that move further apart from each other is known as A. extension. B. decompression. C. expansion. D. rarefaction.

The recommendation for installation of a cable tray system in buildings with removable ceiling tiles is that they be installed with a clearance of ______ or greater above ceiling tiles and supporting T-bars. A. 51 mm (2 in) B. 77 mm (3 in) C. 102 mm (4 in) D. 152 mm (6 in)

The size of the pathway using slots should be one slot sized at ___________ for up to 3716 m2 (40,000 ft2) of usable floor space served by that backbone distribution system. A. 0.03 m2 (45 in2) B. 0.04 m2 (60 in2) C. 0.05 m2 (77 in2) D. 0.06 m2 (90 in2)

In order for an ICT distribution designer to identify the BEST solutions for the client’s needs, they may have to provide A. subcontractors lists. B. material lists (e.g., BOM). C. Operation and Maintenance manuals. D. shop drawings.

An ICT distribution designer installed a 62.5 mm/850 nm fiber optic cable from Building A to Building B with a distance of 1000 m (3280 ft). At Building B the designer fusion splice this new cable to an existing identical 62.5 mm fiber optic cable that runs 700 m (2300 ft) to Building C. Both ends are terminated with ST connectors. What is the WORST case loss budget for the above fiber link? A. 6.20 dB B. 7 dB C. 7.75 dB D. 8.30 dB

In specifying labels and printed tags that meet Underwriters Laboratories (UL) 969 Standard, marking and labeling systems are provided following the listed metrics. Which two of the following are REQUIRED for the UL standard? (Choose two.) A. Adhesion test B. Texture test C. Visual inspection D. Durability test E. Thickness test

When responding to a submittal that has been rejected and/or has comments written by a reviewer, the ICT distribution designer may need to perform which two of the following actions? (Choose two.) A. Review the contract requirements and revise the submittal to comply with these requirements. B. Request a Change Order from the client for the extra work performed. C. Submit an alternate product in lieu of one that was previously submitted, even if it does not meet all of the contract requirements. D. Document the reviewer’s status and/or comments. E. Request a variance from the contract requirements from the client.
Rolling objects create what type of load on an access flooring system? A. Dynamic B. Impact C. Static D. Physical E. Virtual
When preparing an upfront cost estimate, the ICT distribution designer MUST consider which two of the following fees? (Choose two.) A. Taxes B. Safety C. Inspection D. Permits E. Licensing

The owner’s ICT distribution designer is forwarded an RFI from the ICT contractor requesting clarification on certification testing REQUIRED by the specifications for the horizontal cabling plant. The contractor is asking for clarification and permission to submit a wire map test for a Cat6 installation. As the owner’s representative, how does the designer respond? A. A level III field test instrument must be utilized. B. A level IIe field test instrument must be utilized. C. Follow manufacturer recommendations as applicable and submit the results of the wire map testing. D. A level IIIe field test instrument must be utilized.

A commercial office building floor has a usable floor space of ≈1858 m2 (20,000 ft2). What is the MINIMUM number of 103 mm (4 trade size) conduits that shall be required to interconnect the telecommunications rooms on this floor? A. 0 B. 1 C. 2 D. 3

The _____ shall be located in an accessible non-sterile area on each floor of the medical facility. A. equipment control room B. technology distribution room C. technology equipment center D. entrance facility

What is the MINIMUM separation distance from possible sources of EMI in unshielded power lines, or electrical equipment, that exceed 5kVA and are in proximity to a grounded metal communications conduit pathway? A. 152 mm (6 in) B. 305 mm (12 in) C. 610 mm (24 in) D. 1220 mm (48 in)

For a cost estimate, an ICT distribution designer should produce a document listing each task with a cost placed beside them. The type of document used is a A. database. B. worksheet. C. spreadsheet. D. SoW.

What should be considered when designing a fiber network? A. Use a minimum of OM4 multimode fiber to future proof the design. B. Ensure that all connectors are backwards and forward compatible with all applications. C. Ensure the fiber strands provided are sufficient in quantity to accommodate all anticipated needs. D. Ensure that the single mode and multimode hybrid is recommended. E. Design only what you need for today to save money for future upgrades.

In a PTP network using optical fiber, the ______ is responsible for media conversions from the optical fiber to the balanced twisted-pair network within the residence. A. OLT B. OLTS C. OS D. ONT E. ONU
What is the RECOMMENDED bend radius of a conduit with an internal diameter of 51 mm (2 in)? A. 203 mm (8 in) B. 305 mm (12 in) C. 406 mm (16 in) D. 508 mm (20 in)

Which two of the following roles does an ICT distribution designer use to ensure a timely and cost-effective telecommunications construction project? (Choose two.) A. Discuss design concerns with inspectors, AHJs, and other stakeholders. B. Ensure the construction materials are stored properly and protected from theft. C. Assist in the resolution of unforeseen conditions, change orders, RFIs, and changes to the project’s critical path. D. Verify that the overall physical security design complies with the owner expectations. E. Coordinate electrical supply so it is available in advance of the starting of contractor work.
In which phase of the project design would an ICT distribution designer be expected to prepare preliminary cost estimates? A. PD B. CD C. SD D. DD

Before working on equipment, what is the FINAL step in the lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure? A. Confirm all unnecessary items have been removed from the area. B. Confirm the device is de-energized by proving it will not run when started. C. Train workers to perform the LOTO process. D. Apply appropriate tags both locally and remotely. E. Verify the equipment controls are in the proper operating position.

In a building with one joint room for serving as the ER and EF and four dedicated TRs on the same floor, a total of ______ 103 mm (4 trade size) conduits should be installed to interconnect the backbone pathways to the ER. A. 4 B. 8 C. 16 D. 20

The ICT distribution designer is hired to design a Telecommunications Room on the third floor of a building. The size of the floor is 28 m by 26 m (92 x 85 ft). What is to be the MINIMUM size of the TR? A. Shallow Room, no minimum room size B. ≈3 m (10 ft) by ≈2.40 m (8 ft) C. ≈3 m (10 ft) by ≈2.74 m (9 ft) D. ≈3 m (10 ft) by ≈3.40 m (11 ft)
Which type of scheduling chart utilizes predecessor and successor relationships when identifying tasks? A. PERT B. Calender C. Gantt D. Milestone

Conducted coupling may affect electronic devices primarily through which two of the following means? (Choose two.) A. Inductive coupling (by magnetic fields) B. Input signal lines C. Optical signal lines D. Output signal lines E. Capacitive coupling (by electric fields)

An ICT distribution designer installed a 50/125 mm/1300 nm fiber optic cable from Building A to identical Building B with a distance of 600 m (1968 ft). At Building B, the designer fusion splices this new cable to an existing identical 50/125 mm fiber optic cable that runs 800 m (2525 ft) to Building C. Both ends are terminated with SC connectors. What is the loss budget for the above fiber link? A. 2.95 dB B. 3.40 dB C. 3.90 dB D. 4.35 dB
Based on the estimated work area size, what is the MAXIMUM number of work areas that a telecommunications enclosure shall serve? A. 20 B. 26 C. 32 D. 36 E. 40

Which two of the following items MUST be included in a detailed SoW? (Choose two.) A. How the contract performance will be evaluated/judged B. A general description of work to be performed C. Who must approve the Scope of Work D. When the work will start E. What type of work needs to be performed
How many classes of telecommunications administration are there? A. 3 B. 4 C. 5 D. 6

Which two of the following items should be considered for inclusion in a comprehensive working outline of a SoW? (Choose two.) A. Legal matters B. Contract administration C. Financial matters D. Technical considerations E. Schedule

When designing horizontal pathways, the ICT distribution designer should consider the design’s ability to (Choose two.) A. minimize occupant disruption when horizontal pathways are accessed. B. handle at least 3 different cabling media types. C. accommodate at least 50 percent future growth. D. handle only the day one needs as the future is unknown. E. accommodate cabling changes.

What category/class of cabling does BICSI recommend for the MINIMUM performance level of horizontal balanced twisted-pair cabling? A. Category 5e/class D B. Category 6/class E C. Category 6A/class EA D. Category 7/class F

A project’s installation start involves a Kickoff Meeting and the General Contractor’s Coordination Meeting. As part of the ICT distribution designer’s responsibilities, which two of the following are key elements of the Kick-off Meeting? (Choose two.) A. Project submittal approval process B. RFI process C. Punch List process D. Project start and completion dates E. Payment procedures
